releaseNotes: Task Modal HQ Stock Isolation: Tasks for MRs now exclusively display the medical stock belonging to that MR's assigned Headquarters, with cross-HQ stock badges removed from the completion modal
Internal Depot Stock Breakdown: Accurate live stock visibility across all local distribution centers within the HQ (e.g. Tara Pharmacy, Parth Medical Agency in Shahdol)
1-Tap Stockist Selection: Tapping any internal depot automatically fills and selects that distributor for immediate order entry
Mobile Storage & Inventory UI Optimization: Fully redesigned medicine storage cards for crystal-clear visibility on mobile phone screens
Seamless In-Place Update: Release signing ensures smooth APK update without uninstalling or losing device credentials
